story.fullStory:
Cyndi Lauper's "The Goonies R' Good Enough" reached #10 on the Billboard Hot 100. "The Goonies 'R' Good Enough" is a song by American pop singer Cyndi Lauper, released on June 6, 1985, from the soundtrack album The Goonies: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack (1985), released in support of the 1985 film of the same name.

Written by Lauper, Stephen Broughton Lunt, and Arthur Stead in 1984, it was initially titled simply as "Good Enough"; the track was re-titled to "The Goonies 'R' Good Enough" by Warner Bros.

Lauper admitted in an interview that she hated the song.

The song peaked at #10 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

Chart story — peaked at #10 on the Hot 100.

approvedFacts.text: "The Goonies 'R' Good Enough" is a song by American pop singer Cyndi Lauper, released on June 6, 1985, from the soundtrack album The Goonies: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack (1985), released in support of the 1985 film of the same name.
Written by Lauper, Stephen Broughton Lunt, and Arthur Stead in 1984, it was initially titled simply as "Good Enough"; the track was re-titled to "The Goonies 'R' Good Enough" by Warner Bros.
Lauper admitted in an interview that she hated the song.
The song peaked at #10 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.
American singer Cyndi Lauper has released twelve studio albums, fifteen compilation albums, five video albums and fifty-four singles.
Worldwide, Lauper has sold approximately 50 million albums, singles and DVDs.
According to the RIAA, she has sold 9.5 million certified albums in the United States with She's So Unusual being her biggest seller (7× Platinum as of 2023).
